candidates.reason: The torn-paper strip stops at y≈614 with a hard straight bottom edge instead of bleeding off the canvas, which leaves a dead band of about 150px along the bottom. The stamp ring is pulled up away from the mat, so it no longer overlaps the mat's corner as it does in the original. The mat block sits high and the layout is top-heavy.

The torn-paper strip has shrunk into a small floating sliver with hard edges on all sides, so the design's signature torn edge is lost. The stamp ring is blown up far too large and floats on its own above the mat, competing with the polaroid. The mat is jammed low and to the left, leaving the right side and the top as unbalanced empty space.

This is the closest to the original. The stamp still overlaps the mat's top-left corner and the polaroid is centred, but the torn paper ends at y≈650 with a hard, visibly cropped bottom edge and leaves an empty bottom band. The torn edge also cuts across the bottom-right corner of the white polaroid frame next to the caption.

The stamp's overlap with the mat corner is kept, but the torn-paper strip floats with hard straight cutoffs at both the top (y≈75) and the bottom (y≈690), so it looks like a pasted rectangle rather than a page edge. The mat and polaroid are shrunk so the caption is smaller, and the big empty areas at the top and bottom make the layout look like a scaled-down copy.
